description:
## Features

### YouTube
- **Video action bar layout:** Choose Default, Classic One-Row, Classic Two-Rows or Minimal, independent of the layout YouTube sends (ported from Morphe). Existing "Restore old video action bar" selections migrate to Classic One-Row; the removed tablet layout toggle migrates to Classic Two-Rows and takes precedence. New installations use Default. The Classic layouts keep the old-style More videos overlay, and keep Clip, Connect and other overflow actions.
- **Hide action buttons:** Hidden buttons are now removed in every layout, including the Minimal overflow and the separate channel bar of Classic Two-Rows (ported from Morphe). Hiding the channel and Subscribe button also removes standalone channel bars sent by the server.
- **Removed settings:** Restore old video action bar, Enable tablet layout in player, Hide action button by index and Remix button index. The new layout setting and Hide action buttons replace them.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**. The layout setting is hidden on 20.05.46.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54** (no change).

Not device-verified: the Clip and Connect buttons in the Classic layouts, a standalone channel bar sent by the server, and the layouts on YouTube 21.13.164.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.30.0...v1.31.0)
